scope: Four development source-to-object requests, two reversed rounds per stage, fresh compiler processes and cached Base. Includes startup, checking, lowering/optimization and object emission. Excludes linking and generated-program execution. All samples retained.
interpretation: N1 compares compiler implementations produced by the same frozen QBE seed/toolchain. N2 measures the net compiler implementation and generated x86 change. The screens are separate; two rounds provide a bounded guardrail, not statistical significance or broad compiler/research-throughput evidence.
